stem: Write the names of any six factors affecting social health.
solution: Any six factors affecting social health: (1) Unemployment, (2) Poverty, (3) Addiction (alcohol, tobacco, drugs), (4) Illiteracy / lack of education, (5) Superstitions and blind faith, and (6) Crime and terrorism. (Others: corruption, population explosion, gender inequality, misuse of social media / cyber crime.)

stem: What will you do? Why? Your brother studying in XII has developed stress.
solution: What I will do: I will talk to him calmly and listen to his problems patiently, help him plan his studies with a proper time-table and short breaks, encourage him to do regular exercise, yoga, meditation and pursue a hobby, ensure he gets adequate sleep and a balanced diet, and if the stress is severe, seek the help of parents/teachers or a counsellor. Why: Unmanaged stress harms both mental and physical health and reduces concentration and performance. Timely support and relaxation techniques help him overcome the stress, regain confidence and study/perform better.
